depiction.primary_object: exclamation mark inside a hollow circle
depiction.composition: centered symbol enclosed in a bold ring

readings.meaning: alert, warning, error, or critical issue

ambiguity: Can be confused with an inverted 'i' (information icon) at very small sizes, or mistaken for a task priority badge rather than a task subject.
task_intents: respond to compliance or recall notice

example_tasks.task: Draft the root-cause section for Tuesday's checkout outage postmortem
Call fraud department about the suspicious charge alert on Visa
Silence the noisy disk-space warning on staging server 2
Read the HOA violation notice about the front hedge height
Clear the tire pressure fault on the dashboard before the drive
Review the new allergen warning labels for the bakery menu
Assign owners to the three open SEV-2 incidents
Tune thresholds so it stops waking people at 3am
Follow up with dealer on part availability
Gather screenshots and timestamps before Friday's deadline
Fix the unhandled promise rejection error when users submit the signup form offline

example_tasks_es: Revisar las alertas de fraude de la tarjeta de crédito
Silenciar las alarmas falsas de CPU en Datadog
Responder al aviso de infracción del ayuntamiento antes del viernes
example_tasks_ru: Разобрать алерты Sentry после ночного релиза
Проверить чек-энджин на приборной панели в сервисе
Настроить уведомления о критических сбоях сервера в Telegram

context_tasks.task: Pack the emergency roadside kit in the trunk
Test the hallway smoke detector batteries
Update on-call escalation phone numbers in the runbook
Buy a fire extinguisher for under the kitchen sink

near_misses.task: Urgent: buy birthday gift for Mom before tonight
Important: pay quarterly estimated taxes by April 15
Don't forget to water the ferns on the balcony
Ask the information desk at the museum about stroller storage
Set a 6:00 AM alarm for the airport train
Buy a new power cord for the router

reasoning: An exclamation mark inside a circle universally signals an alert, error, warning, or incident. In a task app it fits tasks explicitly about software errors, monitoring alerts, recall/violation notices, or incidents, though it is easily misused as a generic 'urgent/important' property marker and closely resembles the triangle warning icon and the circled 'i' info icon.
